title: HB1821 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to weapons.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2026-01-21; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 3326139)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2026-01-21 (as filed); crossfiled twin shares this text. Adds a new section; deletes nothing. Summary says 'As introduced'. Section 2 sets effect on becoming law.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new section in TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13): Notwithstanding another law to the contrary, in consideration that the right to keep and bear arms is protected and reserved to the people in Article I, § 26, of the Constitution of Tennessee, a person who has not been convicted of a violent, felony crime and who is lawfully able to own or to possess a firearm under the Constitution of Tennessee is considered to be individually licensed and verified by this state within the meaning of the provisions regarding individual licensure and verification in the federal Gun-Free School Zones Act.
